checks.name: Entry CTA
checks.method: Click 拍照识鱼开始 enters the same in-page recognition flow at / without creating another site or route.

checks.name: Source choice first
checks.method: Both 现场拍照 and 从相册选择 are visible before either native picker/camera opens.

checks.name: Camera permission recovery
checks.method: Permission denied/unavailable does not block gallery selection.

checks.name: Shared source session
checks.method: Camera and gallery selections converge to one PhotoSession and same processing pipeline.

checks.name: Complete photo preview
checks.method: EXIF-normalized full source remains contain, not stretched and no fish head/tail cropped.

checks.name: Single sharp photo
checks.method: Across preview, processing and result, no crisp multi-crop collage or different source image; any backdrop is same-source blurred/low-contrast.

checks.name: Automatic model loading
checks.method: Fresh browser can use Detector and Classifier without manual model upload; asset hashes/specs are verified.

checks.name: Cache reuse
checks.method: Second visit reuses version/hash-valid local cache and refreshes when model version changes.

checks.name: Model failure recovery
checks.method: Fetch/hash/runtime failure shows clear retry and never infinite loading or fabricated species.

checks.name: No photo upload
checks.method: Network evidence proves photo bytes are not sent to a remote inference endpoint; model asset downloads are recorded separately.

checks.name: Truthful processing
checks.method: No invented progress percent or fake detector/classifier completion; real inference state is distinct from animation time.

checks.name: SWOS timeline
checks.method: All P0-P7 samples match 0/350/950/1200/1550/2050/2600/2800 ms nominal timing and required relative intensity curve.

checks.name: RR09 timeline
checks.method: R0/R0.5/R1/R2/R3/R4/R5 match 2800/2900/3000/3180/3350/3480/3650 ms; R0.5 is measured geometric midpoint.

checks.name: Late inference
checks.method: If inference exceeds 2800 ms, processing truthfully extends; no fake result and reveal is not compressed.

checks.name: Mask trust gate
checks.method: Only TRUSTED_MASK enables precise contour/gold transfer; BBox is not drawn as fish outline; NONE/STALE uses restrained fallback.

checks.name: Result desktop layout
checks.method: At 1440x1000, 1280x800 and 1024x768 photo is left and result is right with full photo contain.

checks.name: Result stacked layout
checks.method: At 768x1024 and phone widths, photo is above result; no cramped desktop split.

checks.name: Result states
checks.method: HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW/NO_FISH/IMAGE_QUALITY/TECHNICAL_FAILURE render the existing truthful state and recovery actions without threshold changes.

checks.name: No nested scrollbars
checks.method: All required content and CTAs are reachable with ordinary page scroll; no internal photo/result scroll panes.

checks.name: Accessibility and reduced motion
checks.method: Keyboard/focus, 44px targets, status announcements, safe cancellation and prefers-reduced-motion are verified.

checks.name: Exact deployment provenance
checks.method: Evidence names exact Sites source SHA, Version ID, Deployment ID, browser, DPR and viewport.

checks.name: Continuous playback evidence
checks.method: One continuous recording of the same PhotoSession from P0 through R5; separate screenshots do not substitute.

checks.name: Session reset
checks.method: Cancel, retry and fast photo switching invalidate stale result, bbox, mask, species and optical residue.

pass_rule: Every required check must pass on the same exact deployed source SHA. Unrun checks remain NOT_RUN; contract adoption is not runtime visual acceptance.
